Submitted. The repaired proposal keeps the locked **deviation** status and now clears the official minimality gate:

- **Switched from replace to one concise `insert_after` on p0063**, so the existing successors-and-assigns sentence stays byte-for-byte intact instead of being restated.
- **Removed the offending extra words**: "re-price or suspend", "reorganization", and "or delayed".
- **Level held at preferred**, complete and unhybridised: affiliate assignment, merger/acquisition/substantially-all-assets successor assignment, HDI assignment only with our consent not unreasonably withheld, absolute competitor bar, and no HDI termination right on our change of control.
